articles.title: South Korea Will Remain a Key Part of the US’ Chinese Containment Plans
articles.summary: The article suggests that if South Korea and Japan join AUKUS+, effectively a US-led 'Asian NATO', it could solidify the Sino-Russo entente into a de facto alliance. This geopolitical shift risks pushing India into a de facto alliance with the US. Such realignments intensify global strategic partnerships and military balances, reflecting evolving international power dynamics and their implications for regional stability.

articles.title: Iran war tests India's multi-alignment diplomacy
articles.summary: India has consistently showcased its strategic autonomy by skillfully balancing relations with diverse global powers. It has historically bought oil from Iran, built robust defense ties with Israel, and simultaneously strengthened relations with the US. This independent foreign policy approach allows India to expand its economic and strategic influence, demonstrating its capability to navigate complex international geopolitics while prioritizing national interests.

articles.title: Computer Hobby Movement in Canada
articles.summary: Starting in the mid-1970s with limited computer presence in Canadian homes, the world experienced a significant personal computing frenzy within a decade. This period saw the mass manufacturing of diverse computers for home and personal use, marking a pivotal transition towards widespread technological adoption. This global boom transformed everyday life and laid the groundwork for the modern digital age.

articles.title: Giant squid discovery uncovers a hidden deep-sea world off Australia
articles.summary: Scientists off Western Australia's Nyinggulu (Ningaloo) coast discovered a remarkable array of deep-sea marine life. Expeditions unveiled evidence of giant squid and multiple previously undocumented species, significantly enhancing our understanding of ocean biodiversity. This discovery highlights advanced marine research capabilities and the vast, unexplored depths, offering crucial insights for global conservation and scientific study.

articles.title: Orbit International Corp. Reports 2026 First Quarter Results
articles.summary: A company reported a net loss of $1,546,000 ($0.46 per share) for the First Quarter 2026. This marks a positive financial trend, as it represents a significant improvement compared to the $2,152,000 ($0.65 per share) net loss incurred during the comparable period in the prior year, indicating a narrowing deficit.

articles.title: Gold recycling schemes on the rise after gold prices move up: How your old jewellery is evaluated and what price you get
articles.summary: Major Indian gold jewellery players like Kalyan Jewellers and Malabar Gold & Diamonds are actively promoting gold recycling schemes. This initiative comes amid a significant increase in gold imports, aiming to reduce the nation's reliance on foreign gold and support domestic circular economy practices. Such schemes could help manage trade deficits and promote sustainable resource use.

articles.title: How to bet on PGA Championship 2026: Betting guide, odds, picks, field, tips, promos, offers for Aronimink
articles.summary: Aronimink Golf Club in Pennsylvania is set to host the 2026 PGA Championship, marking its second major tournament. This prestigious golf event continues its legacy, having previously hosted the 1962 PGA Championship, won by golf legend Gary Player. The championship attracts top international golfers, highlighting its global significance in the sport.
